dct_description_sm:
Dataset has four locations:

Top Lake:

Location: 68.757N, 133.520W

Rods: 4 (central), 7 (23 cm above central rod in dip direction), 1 (25 cm from central rod in strike direction [west]), 6 (23 cm below central rod in dip direction), 20 (10 m from headwall; slump floor)

Deployment: 2018-06-15 - 2018-08-05

Evan Lake:

Location: 68.754N, 133.464W

Rods: 9 (central)

Deployment: 2018-06-13 - 2018-08-24

Roadside:

Location: 69.007N, 133.361W

Rods: 10 (central), 2 (20 cm above central rod in dip direction), 8 (20 cm from central rod in strike direction [west]), 3 (20 cm below central rod in dip direction) Deployment: 2018-06-27 - 2018-08-21

Timbit Lake: Location: 69.105N, 133.290W Rods: 5 (central) Deployment: 2018-06-15 - lost

This record is for the dataset “Temperature profile measurements in the debris-covered headwalls of four thaw slumps in the Tuktoyaktuk Coastlands, Northwest Territories, Canada” at https://zenodo.org/doi/10.5281/zenodo.3457280

Each XX.txt file contains the native output of the iButton software by maxim integrated for probe XX. A calibration offset can be estimated from the average temperature recorded during the ice-bath calibration period.

This dataset can be downloaded at: https://zenodo.org/doi/10.5281/zenodo.3457280
